meta.source: Art Institute of Chicago public data dump, CC0 metadata (https://api.artic.edu/docs/)
meta.provenance: Snapshot of the Art Institute of Chicago data dump taken 2026-11-01 by tools/build_pool.py. Catalog facts only; no images and no descriptions. Credit: The Art Institute of Chicago.
meta.selection: Every artwork with a title that the museum's data marks as on view when the snapshot was taken. What is on view changes; this is one day's list.
